evidence.excerpt: The key question is then not raw recall alone, but which memory design gives the best quality--token trade-off in the compact-memory regime.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On AMA-Bench, our primary compact-memory benchmark, it reaches $83%$ of Full-Context quality at $32%$ of the token cost at a $4$k budget; under four-seed averaging it beats the closest streaming-clustered baseline (Online K-Means) by $+3.5$--$6.0$,pp ($p{<}.001$) across the whole ${\sim}2.6$k--${\sim}5$k regime.
